beforeShellExecution.command: f=.designkit/scripts/hook.mjs; [ -f "$f" ] && command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; node "$f" before-command --tool cursor

beforeMCPExecution.command: f=.designkit/scripts/hook.mjs; [ -f "$f" ] && command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; node "$f" before-command --tool cursor

postToolUse.command: f=.designkit/scripts/hook.mjs; [ -f "$f" ] && command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; node "$f" after-edit --tool cursor
